column1: Note 1:OCNG shall be used such that the resources in cell # 1 are fully allocated and a constant total transmitted power spectral density is achieved for all OFDM symbols.Note 2:The uplink resources for CQI reporting are assigned to the UE prior to the start of time period T1.Note 3:The timers and layer 3 filtering related parameters are configured prior to the start of time period T1.Note 4:The signal contains PDCCH for UEs other than the device under test as part of OCNG.Note 5:SNR levels correspond to the signal to noise ratio over the cell-specific reference signal REs.Note 6:The SNR in time periods T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 is denoted as SNR1, SNR2, SNR3, SNR4 and SNR5 respectively in figure A.7.3.6.1-1.Note 7:The SNR values are specifed for testing a UE which supports 2RX on at least one band. For testing of a UE which supports 4RX on all bands, the SNR during T3 and T4 is modified as specified in section A.3.8.1.
